text: {"claims": [{"quote": "Meta Platforms delivered a solid finish to fiscal 2023, generating $116.9\u202fB in revenue, a modest 6\u202f% increase from the prior year, and $40.1\u202fB of net income, yielding EPS of $11.94.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Operating cash flow reached $45.2\u202fB, supporting a robust operating margin of roughly 45\u202f% and a net margin near 34\u202f%.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "Fiscal 2022 marked a rebound in top\u2011line growth, with revenue of $116.6\u202fB, up 13\u202f% year\u2011over\u2011year, and net income of $39.6\u202fB (EPS $11.55). Operating cash flow was $38.9\u202fB, sustaining an operating margin around 44\u202f% and a net margin of 34\u202f%.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "The prior two years showed stronger acceleration: fiscal 2021 revenue of $103.5\u202fB (+21\u202f% YoY) and net income of $39.5\u202fB (EPS $11.45) with operating cash flow of $33.5\u202fB, while fiscal 2020 revenue of $85.0\u202fB (+19\u202f% YoY) produced net income of $29.0\u202fB (EPS $9.5) and operating cash flow of $27.0\u202fB.", "verdict": "wrong"}, {"quote": "The stock remains attractively valued relative to its cash\u2011flow generation, supporting a hold rating with a target price near $560.", "verdict": "unchecked"}, {"quote": "The company's advertising business continued to benefit from cross\u2011platform integration and expanding AR/VR initiatives, though growth slowed relative to the double\u2011digit rates of earlier years.", "verdict": "unchecked"}], "action": "block"}
